1.  **$DP_{max}(i)$**: The maximum sum of a valid subsequence $T \subset \{1, \ldots, i\}$ such that $t_k = i$.
2.  **$DP_{min}(i)$**: The minimum sum of a valid subsequence $T \subset \{1, \ldots, i\}$ such that $t_k = i$.

**Recurrence Relations:**

The value of $DP(i)$ depends on whether we start a new subsequence at $i$ (sum is $a_i$), or extend a sequence ending at $i-1$ or $i-2$.

$$
DP_{max}(i) = a_i + \max \left( 0, DP_{max}(i-1), DP_{max}(i-2) \right)
$$
$$
DP_{min}(i) = a_i + \min \left( 0, DP_{min}(i-1), DP_{min}(i-2) \right)
